name: skills
description: Personal agent skill collection with amo workflow skills plus practical tool skills for engineering workflows.

plugins.name: amo-feature
plugins.description: Use when the user asks how to design or implement a new feature, capability, workflow, page, API, or behavior before coding. Do not use for bug fixes, intentional changes to existing behavior, pure refactors, or second-pass solution challenges.

plugins.name: amo-improve
plugins.description: Use when the user asks how to improve, extend, adjust, or redesign an existing feature or behavior before coding. Do not use for brand-new features, broken behavior, pure refactors, or second-pass solution challenges.

plugins.name: amo-fix
plugins.description: Use when the user asks why existing behavior is broken, incorrect, flaky, regressed, unexpected, or runtime/build behavior is failing and wants a bug-fix approach before coding. Do not use for planned feature changes, pure refactors, or second-pass solution challenges.

plugins.name: amo-refactor
plugins.description: Use when the user asks how to refactor, split modules, clarify architecture, move ownership, reduce coupling, or fix unclear state, data-flow, or component boundaries before coding. Do not use for ordinary feature work, bug fixes, or second-pass solution challenges.

plugins.name: amo-best
plugins.description: Use when the user challenges an existing proposal, asks whether it is the best solution, asks for a better approach, or wants second-pass review of the chosen best-standard, tradeoffs, scope, compatibility, risk, or refactor depth before implementation.

plugins.name: amo-review
plugins.description: Use when the user asks to review implemented code for code style, redundancy, unnecessary abstractions, wrappers, helpers, adapters, parsers, type guards, TypeScript type noise, or composable usage clarity.

plugins.name: amo-draft
plugins.description: Use when the user asks to write or edit development-time content, website or page copy, requirement notes, implementation docs, version notes, release notes, or temporary project documentation, especially when reference material, examples, chat history, or implementation process could pollute the target artifact.

plugins.name: brand-asset-generator
plugins.description: Use when generating or wiring project-ready brand image assets from a user-provided logo, mark, or icon source image, including transparent source marks, favicon, PWA icons, apple touch icons, desktop app icons, tray icons, ICO, and ICNS outputs.

plugins.name: doc-feat-desc
plugins.description: Use when the user wants user-facing docs for an implemented feature. Inspect the real implementation first, then write help-center, site-copy, and in-product docs under doc/{requirement-name}.

plugins.name: draft-to-project
plugins.description: Convert UI drafts such as screenshots, HTML drafts, local file:// prototype pages, or mockups into frontend pages inside an existing project while keeping the draft layout structure close to the source.

plugins.name: git-smart-commit
plugins.description: Use when the user wants a commit message or wants to refine one. Detect the repo's commit convention first, then generate a matching header; include a short body when one intent spans multiple areas.

plugins.name: global-project-rules
plugins.description: Use as always-on project rules for agent behavior in any repository: Chinese replies, senior engineer style, simple maintainable solutions, clear APIs, and no state-changing git commands unless explicitly requested.

plugins.name: operate-worktree
plugins.description: MANUAL-ONLY git worktree skill. Absorbs a git worktree branch back into the main checkout by rebasing its commits onto the main checkout's current branch (linear history, every commit preserved, no merge commit), fast-forwarding a personal target branch. Never deletes the worktree directory or branch name; never touches remotes. Run only on explicit invocation of operate-worktree.

plugins.name: signature-svg-generator
plugins.description: Use when generating reusable font-based signature assets. Emits static and animated SVG/Vue/React artifacts under signatures/<text-slug>/ by default, including personal signatures, handwritten wordmarks, font-derived paths, and mask-based handwriting animations.

plugins.name: solution-design-review
plugins.description: Use when the user asks for an implementation plan, bug-fix approach, best solution, root-cause analysis, refactor strategy, or tradeoff discussion before coding.

plugins.name: split-pencil-file
plugins.description: Split an imported Pencil .pen design file into one folder per top-level Frame, each containing index.pen and the local image assets referenced by that frame.

plugins.name: zcode-skills-sync
plugins.description: MANUAL-ONLY maintenance skill. Rebuilds ~/.zcode/skills as symlinks into ~/.cc-switch/skills when the user explicitly invokes zcode-skills-sync.
